parentSkill.name: three_createWorld_wrapper_conservative_instancing_v4
parentSkill.description: Conservatively rewrites modules exporting createWorld(THREE, scene) into a wrapper around the original factory. The wrapper preserves the original initialization and update logic, then inspects the created scene graph at runtime and batches only repeated sibling opaque meshes with fully compatible geometry data and render-relevant material properties into THREE.InstancedMesh. It detaches original meshes from the rendered graph but keeps the objects alive for existing update references, copies each original world transform back into instance matrices after every update, preserves stable semantic identities from userData.semanticId or name, and patches instanced raycast results to map hit.instanceId back onto the original mesh object rather than fabricating a replacement. It is conservative, skips unsupported shapes and materials, avoids package/build/test files, and returns no changes when prerequisites are not matched.
